decisive_spans.text: MRI of the spine revealed contiguous spondylitis from T6 to T10 with discitis and an epidural/paraspinal collection causing spinal cord compression

response.rationale: D2 is supported by the MRI findings of spondylitis, discitis, and an epidural/paraspinal collection, which are consistent with osteomyelitis. D4 is also supported by the same MRI findings, but D2 is more specific given the overall context of the case (which includes positive MTB findings in other parts of the body, though not explicitly stated in the support for D2). The margin is low because both D2 and D4 are strongly supported by the same evidence, but D2 is a more precise diagnosis in the context of the overall case.
